name: Sandberg Capital

entity_kind.quote: We are an alternative investment fund management company that focuses on investing in small and medium-sized companies in the region of Central and Eastern Europe, with a primary focus on Slovakia and Czech Republic.

investor_type.quote: Sandberg Capital, a private equity investment group, is entering HotelTime, a leading provider of hotel software, through its second fund, Sandberg Investment Fund II (SIF2).

sectors.quote: Our portfolio consists of investments in the IT, agriculture, telecommunications, retail and education sectors.

stages.quote: are in the growth or mature stage of the company´s life cycle.

ticket_max.quote: The typical investment size per project is up to EUR 50 million, targeting companies with a minimum of EUR 2 million in EBITDA.

aum.quote: We manage assets in the value of more than 500 mil. EUR.

investments.quote: Private equity group Sandberg Capital, through its second fund Sandberg Investment Fund II, has acquired a majority stake in Carrot, a leading Polish digital B2B platform for online auctions of vehicles following insurance claims.

Travelnode, a hospitality technology platform majority-owned by private equity firms Sandberg Capital and ARX Equity Partners, has acquired Rentlio, Croatia’s second-largest hospitality software provider.
Sandberg Capital, a private equity investment group, is entering HotelTime, a leading provider of hotel software, through its second fund, Sandberg Investment Fund II (SIF2).

notes: Bratislava-based mid-market PE (tech-heavy, also agriculture, retail, education and real estate). Carrot was the final investment of SIF II, so no fund is currently in its investment period unless a successor fund exists (not found). SLOVCA profile lists EUR 4-15m tickets, the fund page says up to EUR 50m, so only ticket_max from the own site is recorded. Rentlio is an add-on via portfolio company Travelnode (co-owned with ARX, c001); HotelTime date = article publication date.
